replication: per-seed and pooled; no single-seed conclusion
primary_question: When Baby emits the first wrong answer token after an otherwise-correct answer prefix, if we repair ONLY that token and return to free greedy AR generation, does she recover the correct answer?

part1_population.rule: T28 greedy first-token-correct-then-diverge on DEV, all three terminal checkpoints

part2_primary_intervention.procedure: Teacher-force the shared prefix through first_divergence_pos-1, replace ONLY the diverging token with gold, then free greedy with no further oracle until native EOS or max_new=16

part3_controls_frozen_before_rescue.note: Control tokens are assigned from frozen population fields, inventory geometry, token class/length/frequency. They are not chosen using rescue success.

B.name: WRONG_MATCHED_CONTROL
B.rule: Among vocab ids 0..1023 excluding gold_token and the naturally generated wrong_token, take same token_class and same utf8 piece length as gold, then closest Phase1G train frequency, then smallest |id-gold|, then smallest id. If empty, relax length (same class, closest length then frequency). If still empty, relax class (closest frequency). Record match_tier. Never gold.

C.name: NO_INTERVENTION
C.rule: Original free greedy sequence. Exact+EOS is 0 by population construction.

D.name: PREFIX_COMPATIBLE_WRONG_TOKEN
D.rule: Among the 24 authorized inventory names, take the lexicographically first name whose token ids share gold prefix target[:div_pos] and whose next token exists and differs from gold_token. That next token is D. If none, D is infeasible for that row and is not substituted.

token_class_rule.punct: decoded piece has no alphanumeric characters

part4.shared_vs_unique: DEV-name first-token collision as in the tokenizer diagnostic (Omar/Opal and Sal/Skye are the only DEV shared-first groups)

part5.at_divergence: final-layer softmax P/rank/margin for gold, natural wrong, B, D (if feasible), and top1, on prefix prompt+target[:div_pos]
part5.after_gold_repair: same stats for the next remaining gold token on prefix prompt+target[:div_pos]+[gold]
part5.trajectory: teacher-forced remaining gold suffix after the repaired token: P/rank/margin of each next gold token
part5.language: descriptive; not a causal claim about internal use

part6.sites: after blocks 7-11 (layer index 8..12 in the embedding=0 / after-block-k = k+1 numbering), frozen LM head after Baby final_norm
part6.contrast: prefix after appending wrong_token vs gold_token; readout of the NEXT remaining gold token
part6.store: compact ranks/margins only; no activation dumps

part7.if_gold_rescue_large_and_replicated: STOP; document earned hypothesis only; do not design the next treatment

classification_rule_frozen_before_rescue.INCONCLUSIVE: n per seed < 20 OR (max-min gold exact+EOS rate across seeds) >= 0.30
classification_rule_frozen_before_rescue.MIXED_BY_COLLISION_FAMILY: both shared-first and unique-first DEV groups have n>=20 and their gold exact+EOS rates differ by >= 0.30
classification_rule_frozen_before_rescue.EARLY_TOKEN_ERROR_CAUSALLY_DOMINATES: pooled gold exact+EOS >= 0.70 AND min seed >= 0.60 AND (gold - max(B pooled, D-feasible pooled)) >= 0.40
classification_rule_frozen_before_rescue.EARLY_TOKEN_ERROR_MAJOR_CONTRIBUTOR: pooled gold exact+EOS >= 0.40 AND min seed >= 0.25 AND (gold - max(B, D-feasible)) >= 0.20
classification_rule_frozen_before_rescue.EARLY_TOKEN_REPAIR_PARTIAL_RECOVERY: pooled gold exact+EOS < 0.40 AND (pooled next-token recovery >= 0.50 OR pooled remaining-suffix exact >= 0.30) AND at least 2/3 seeds show next-token recovery >= 0.40 or remaining-suffix exact >= 0.20
classification_rule_frozen_before_rescue.EARLY_TOKEN_REPAIR_NO_MEANINGFUL_EFFECT: pooled gold exact+EOS < 0.15 AND pooled next-token recovery < 0.20
classification_rule_frozen_before_rescue.fallback: INCONCLUSIVE if none of the above match

success_bar_note: This study does not reopen Phase 2A success gates and does not authorize TEST or T29.
